titleEn: Offaly dairy farm extends grazing season with Lely Grazeway
titleZh: 奥法利奶牛场借助Lely Grazeway延长放牧季节
summaryZh: 爱尔兰奥法利郡一家奶牛场采用Lely机器人挤奶系统与Grazeway智能选通门，将奶牛放牧季节延长一个月。该系统通过分时段引导奶牛至不同放牧区块，实现每日三次挤奶，提高采食量，减少群体拥挤和蹄部损伤，同时降低劳动力需求，改善牧场管理。该案例展示了机器人技术与放牧管理的有效结合，为智慧畜牧提供了实践参考。
featuredReason: 该案例展示了机器人挤奶与智能放牧系统结合如何显著延长放牧季节、提升效率并改善动物福利，为智慧畜牧在奶牛养殖中的落地提供了宝贵实践参考。
contentFull: Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Sponsored Offaly dairy farm extends grazing season with Lely Grazeway ![Image 1: Agriland Team By Agriland Team August 20, 2026 5:00 AM](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsauthoragriland-team) Share this article ![Image 2](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsoffaly-dairy-farm-extends-grazing-season-with-lely-grazeway) Sponsored by !Image 3 Despite farming heavy soils in Co. Offaly, Aisling Heavey says cows are spending an extra month at grass since switching to robotic milking and installing a Lely Grazeway. Aisling farms alongside her father Bernard, milking 133 spring-calving cows near Tullamore, supplying Lakeland Dairies. They also finish around 110 homebred beef animals at their 400ac mixed farm. The family invested in a new greenfield dairy unit with two Lely A5 Astronaut milking robots in 2020, replacing their 10-year-old conventional parlour. At the same time, they increased cow numbers from 115 to 130. Around 30ac of the farm’s grazing platform could only be accessed by crossing a public road. While an underpass was an option, the high cost meant the Heaveys decided to reduce the grazing platform to 85ac. About the grazing system They say embracing robots and using a Lely Grazeway has helped change their grazing mindset. The Heaveys now operate an ABC grazing system, with cows allocated to one of three grazing blocks, depending on the time of day. The Lely Grazeway is an intelligent selection gate that decides if a cow should be directed back to the shed or out to one of the three blocks. ![Image 4](https:images.agriland.ieLssuqp1kuplStlf5HxSJAFijemE7kTFWYCJD9P7ZEArs:fit:1024:0bg:FFFFFFplainhttps:cdn.agriland.ieuploads202608screenshot-2026-08-18-122639.png) Grainne Murray, Lely Mullingar Farm Management Support (FMS) specialist, said: “The reason we do this is to increase intakes, break up herd mentality and reduce bunching. "Most importantly, it improves cow flow and helps maximise the efficiency of the robot." During the night, the Grazeway directs cows to the paddock closest to the milking shed. Block A opens at 2:00a.m, Block B at 10:00am and Block C at 6:00p.m. Around 20% of the daily allocation is offered overnight, with the remaining 80% split between the daytime blocks. ![Image 5](https:images.agriland.ieA-tP4XMedeGOETk6-k4p3Uaop0obHKXdMoQ5ickfdErs:fit:1024:0bg:FFFFFFplainhttps:cdn.agriland.ieuploads202608screenshot-2026-08-18-123137.png) The reason for the three blocks is to aim for three times a day milking. However, not all cows will visit all three blocks within a 24-hour time period. This will depend on yield and intake, the higher yielding or greedy cow will visit all three blocks. Benefits of the robots The Heaveys say robots have transformed their grazing management. Bernard said: “We are now out grazing in February, which we never would have dreamt of with the parlour." Aisling added: “Previously, cows wouldn’t have gone out until St. Patrick’s Day, and we would house earlier in the autumn, too." ![Image 6](https:images.agriland.ieppdTZx6lPvdByHurgFiZtJEXQNmPE8yAvcCW9H5RmScrs:fit:1024:0bg:FFFFFFplainhttps:cdn.agriland.ieuploads202608screenshot-2026-08-18-123018.png) Bernard believes allowing cows to move freely has reduced poaching in gateways and improved ground conditions. “If we get heavy rain and cows want to come back inside, they will,” he explained. Simpler daily routine It used to take six hours daily to milk, but the robots have simplified the daily routine, Aisling explained. “Once the calving and breeding seasons are finished, the workload is reduced significantly. "We only have two grazing wires to move in the morning and one in the evening. "Then we change the milking filter socks, wash the robots and monitor data using Lely Horizon,” she added. She believes having more time to focus on grazing has made them better grassland managers. Calmer cows The family has also noticed a significant change in cow behaviour. Aisling said: “Our cows are an awful lot quieter. "They move around in ones and twos or twos and threes, rather than as a herd, so there is much less pressure on the grazing platform." Introducing the robots proved more straightforward than expected and cows adapted well. Initially, only 30 cows were trained to go through the robots when they were first switched on because the remainder had been dried off. The following spring, cows went straight onto robots as they calved. Bernard says the support provided by Lely Mullingar while they were getting established was brilliant and gave them confidence using the technology. Aisling adds: “If someone was considering getting into grazing with robots, I would say definitely go for it. It really does work and it is a calm and flexible system.” Call Lely Center Mullingar today on (044) 933 0320 to find out more. translationZh:
尽管在奥法利郡经营着粘重土壤，艾斯林·希维表示，自从改用机器人挤奶并安装Lely Grazeway后，奶牛在草地上的时间多了一个月。

艾斯林与父亲伯纳德一起经营，在塔拉莫尔附近饲养133头春季产犊奶牛，供应给Lakeland Dairies。他们还在400英亩的混合农场中育肥约110头自繁肉牛。

2020年，该家庭投资建设了一个全新的绿地奶牛场，配备两台Lely A5 Astronaut挤奶机器人，取代了使用10年的传统挤奶厅。同时，他们将奶牛数量从115头增加到130头。

农场放牧区约有30英亩需要穿过一条公共道路才能到达。虽然地下通道是一个选择，但高昂的成本使希维一家决定将放牧区缩减至85英亩。

**关于放牧系统**

他们表示，拥抱机器人并使用Lely Grazeway帮助他们改变了放牧观念。希维一家现在采用ABC放牧系统，根据一天中的不同时间，将奶牛分配到三个放牧区之一。Lely Grazeway是一个智能选择门，决定奶牛是应该被引导回牛舍还是前往三个放牧区之一。

Lely Mullingar农场管理支持专家格兰妮·默里表示：“我们这样做是为了增加采食量，打破群体思维，减少聚集。最重要的是，它改善了奶牛流动，有助于最大化挤奶机器人的效率。”

夜间，Grazeway将奶牛引导至离挤奶棚最近的围场。A区在凌晨2:00开放，B区在上午10:00开放，C区在下午6:00开放。每日约20%的饲喂量在夜间提供，其余80%分配在白天各区块。

设置三个区块的目的是为了实现每日三次挤奶。然而，并非所有奶牛都会在24小时内访问所有三个区块。这取决于产奶量和采食量，高产或贪吃的奶牛会访问所有三个区块。

**机器人的好处**

希维一家表示，机器人彻底改变了他们的放牧管理。伯纳德说：“我们现在二月就开始放牧，这在以前用挤奶厅时是想都不敢想的。”艾斯林补充道：“以前，奶牛要到圣帕特里克节才会出去，秋天也会提前关入牛舍。”

伯纳德认为，让奶牛自由活动减少了门口区域的践踏，改善了地面条件。“如果下大雨，奶牛想回牛舍，它们就会回来，”他解释道。

**日常流程更简单**

艾斯林解释说，过去每天挤奶需要六个小时，但机器人简化了日常流程。“一旦产犊和配种季节结束，工作量就大大减少。我们早上只需移动两根放牧电线，晚上移动一根。然后更换挤奶过滤袜，清洗机器人，并使用Lely Horizon监控数据，”她补充道。她认为，有更多时间专注于放牧使他们成为了更好的草地管理者。

**奶牛更平静**

这家人还注意到奶牛行为发生了显著变化。艾斯林说：“我们的奶牛安静多了。它们以一两只或两三只一组移动，而不是成群结队，因此放牧区的压力小了很多。”

引入机器人的过程比预期更顺利，奶牛适应得很好。最初，只有30头奶牛在机器人首次启动时接受训练，因为其余奶牛已经干奶。第二年春天，奶牛在产犊后直接使用机器人。

伯纳德表示，Lely Mullingar在他们建立系统期间提供的支持非常出色，让他们对使用这项技术充满信心。艾斯林补充道：“如果有人考虑用机器人进行放牧，我会说一定要试试。它确实有效，而且是一个平静灵活的系统。”
